title: Rewrite create_meeting_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/meetings/createMeeting/widgets/create_meeting_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: FORM + DROPDOWN.

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** CreateMeetingCubit(meetingsRepository) is already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**Constructor param:** Receives carnivalBlockId as a constructor param from the router (e.g. `const CreateMeetingScreen({super.key, required this.carnivalBlockId})`). Preserve the constructor signature.

**Widgets to use:** AppAppBar(title: 'Nova reunião'), AppCard, AppTextField (title field), AppTextField (date/time field - use a DateTime picker triggered on tap or icon suffix), AppDropdown<CarnivalBlocksEntity> (for block selection if multiple blocks available; pre-select when carnivalBlockId provided), AppButton(label: 'Criar', variant: .primary, isFullWidth: true), AppSnackbar.

**Layout guidance:**
1. AppAppBar with title 'Nova reunião', showBackButton: true.
2. Body: SingleChildScrollView > AppCard with the form.
3. Fields in order:
   - AppDropdown<CarnivalBlocksEntity>(label: 'Bloco', value: state.selectedBlock ?? (initial block matching carnivalBlockId), items: blocks.map(...).toList(), onChanged: cubit.selectBlock) - skip if only one block available
   - AppTextField(label: 'Título da reunião', hint: 'Ex.: Ensaio geral', TextInputAction.next)
   - AppTextField(label: 'Data e hora', readOnly: true, suffixIcon: Icons.event_rounded, onTap: showDatePicker+TimePicker, value formatted via DateFormat.yMd('pt_BR').add_Hm())
   - AppTextField(label: 'Local', optional - if exists)
4. AppButton at bottom - isLoading when state.status == loading; isDisabled when required fields empty.
5. On submit success: AppSnackbar.success('Reunião criada com sucesso'), context.pop().
6. On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message.

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature (including carnivalBlockId), cubit API, all pt-BR strings, date/time formatting via package:intl.
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Screen widget class name `CreateMeetingScreen` and constructor `const CreateMeetingScreen({super.key, required this.carnivalBlockId})` preserved (carnivalBlockId is required)
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
AppDropdown<CarnivalBlocksEntity> used for block selection (when applicable)
Date/time picker shows DateFormat.yMd('pt_BR').add_Hm() formatted value in readOnly AppTextField
On submit success: AppSnackbar.success then context.pop()
